subject: Lumen Health — Stagewise app onboarding & term extension request
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@lumenhealth.com>
Cc:  
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lumen Health — Stagewise app onboarding & term extension request

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our call, Lumen is looking to onboard an additional set of projects into the same tenant as part of Q4 work:

- Patient Intake Forms (web)
- Clinical Decision Assistant (internal tool)
- Billing Reconciliation (batch jobs)
- Appointment Chatbot (mobile)

High level asks from your side were: additional API keys per app, a staged rollout plan (feature-flag gating + canary), and clarity on term & capacity impact if you want these live before your existing renewal date.

Attached is an AMP matrix that maps expected traffic profiles to recommended pool sizing (AMP_matrix.xlsx). Can you confirm:
1) whether you want separate API keys per project or a shared key scoped by namespace?
2) an expected go-live window for each project (we can do staged provisioning over 6 weeks).

If you prefer, we can propose a short addendum to your current contract that covers a 6-month extension to accommodate the additional committed units and keep unit-pricing favorable. I’ll loop legal and CS once we have your preferred key/rollout model.

Next step suggestion: quick alignment call early next week (30 min) to lock the milestones so we can provision test keys and SOW draft. Are you available Mon/Tue morning PT?

Thanks,

Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri yom_das@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: AMP_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48 KB)
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@lumenhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lumen Health — Stagewise app onboarding & term extension request

Priyom —

Thanks for the summary and the AMP matrix, that’s helpful. We do want separate API keys per project for auditability (one key per codebase/team). Timeline-wise: Appointment Chatbot and Patient Intake should be live before the end of October; the other two teams can be phased in November.

Procurement has asked for an SOW + pricing for the committed capacity and any term-change options. I’ve CC’d the procurement mailbox (procure@lumenhealth.com) for visibility.

Mon morning PT works for a 30-min sync. If you can send a draft SOW ahead of the call, procurement will start an internal review in parallel.

—Alicia
Senior Product Manager, Clinical Platforms
Lumen Health

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lumen Health — Stagewise app onboarding & term extension request

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the timeline. I’ve attached a draft SOW and a concise pricing summary that reflects a 6-month addendum to your existing term so you keep the current committed rates for the additional units.

Key points in the draft (SOW_v2.pdf attached):
- Scope: provisioning of 4 additional API keys (one per app) plus tenant-scoped routing and namespace isolation for logs.
- Rollout cadence: test keys within 3 business days of PO; staging keys for feature-flag canary 2 weeks after test; production keys rolled weekly per-app.
- Capacity: initial reserved pool sized for the appointment chatbot peak (see table), with autoscaling headroom for batch jobs.
- Term adjustment: optional 6-month extension to cover increased committed tokens; pricing table shows committed vs burst rates.

Next steps (action items):
1) Alicia / Procurement: confirm PO intent and whether you will sign the 6-month addendum (we can convert to monthly billed over the term).
2) Redwood Legal: prepare addendum & minor redlines (we’ll push turnaround within 3 business days).
3) Redwood CS (Ben): schedule a provisioning window and pre-flight checklist for keys/roles.

Ben — please confirm capacity estimate and whether we should recommend a temporary soft quota for the Patient Intake web team to avoid accidental spikes during testing.

Alicia — I’ll be on the alignment call Mon 09/21 10:00 AM PT (invitation to follow). I’ll upload the SOW to the Drive link below; procurement can attach comments there.

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0224

Attachment: SOW_v2.pdf (document, 112 KB)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cExampleLink
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@lumenhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lumen Health — Stagewise app onboarding & term extension request

Alicia / team —

Thanks — confirmed for the Mon 10:00 AM PT sync. Quick notes before the call:

- We’ll provision one test API key per app scoped to a non-prod namespace. Test keys will have quota caps (recommended 10k tokens/day) to catch integration loops.
- For production keys we recommend RBAC: app-key (read/write), infra-key (admin), and a CI-only key for batch reconciliation jobs with restricted IP egress.
- If procurement signs the 6-month addendum, we’ll pre-allocate burst capacity and avoid throttling during the Oct go-lives. Otherwise we’ll rely on burst-tier with higher per-token pricing.

Looking forward to the alignment call. I’ll bring the provisioning checklist and request access to the tenant admin email for the automated key delivery.

-Ben
